This is a leave-your-sweatshirt-on, pull-up-a-chair kind of dinner. 🍂🍗

Lemon-herb chicken thighs, roasted potatoes and carrots, with garlic and rosemary doing their part. Nothing fancy required—just a meal worth sitting down for.

A little inspiration from Roswell Family Farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY, for your next cool-weather supper. 💚

Browse chicken cuts and submit your request:
https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/chicken-orders.html

We’ll confirm availability and your final cost.

Follow our family farm for meal ideas and a look at where your food begins.

#RoswellFamilyFarm #UpstateNY #ChickenDinner #NewYorkFarms

Some people have a porch with a view. Ours comes with a harvest. 🌽🚜

Insight Dairy is harvesting the corn they planted on Emily’s grandparents’ land, and we’ve got a front-porch seat from her grandparents’ house—the place we now call home.

The leaves are starting to turn, the equipment is moving, and another local farm is bringing in the crop they’ve worked for.

Family land. A neighboring farm’s hard work. A little glimpse of fall here in Salisbury, New York. 💚

Wishing the Insight Dairy crew a safe harvest!

#RoswellFamilyFarm #InsightDairy #NewYorkFarms #HarvestSeason

🍂🐷 SWEATER WEATHER. FREEZER GOALS.

Your freezer called. It’s ready for something besides ice cubes. 😂

Roswell Family Farm’s fall whole and half hog special is here:

🐷 WHOLE HOG — $2.75/lb hanging weight
🐷 HALF HOG — $3.00/lb hanging weight

Only SIX whole hogs available, with whole or half reservations offered.

📍 Processing at Empire Custom Processing in Bridgewater, NY.
📅 Planned for October 5 or 6—exact date pending confirmation.

Processing is NOT included in the prices above. Customers are responsible for paying processing fees directly to the processor.

Your farm total is based on actual hanging weight, before cutting and packaging. The weight of the meat you take home will be lower.

💬 MESSAGE ROSWELL FAMILY FARM TO RESERVE

Reservation deposits must be paid by cash or Venmo. Message us first to confirm your reservation and receive payment instructions. Your deposit is applied toward your final farm balance.

Please do not use our regular online hog checkout for this special—it reflects our regular pricing.

Available until all six hogs are reserved or reservations close for processing, whichever comes first. We’ll announce the cutoff once the processing date is confirmed.

From our family farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY, to your fall dinner plans. 💚
